translations.web: But the very hairs of your head are all counted. Therefore don’t be afraid. You are of more value than many sparrows.
translations.bsb: And even the very hairs of your head are all numbered. So do not be afraid; you are worth more than many sparrows.
translations.kjv: But even the very hairs of your head are all numbered. Fear not therefore: ye are of more value than many sparrows.
